convert_xlm_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert an XLM checkpoint to PyTorch format by loading model weights, config, and vocab
run_convert_cli: run the XLM checkpoint conversion CLI with xlm checkpoint path and output folder path arguments
load_xlm_checkpoint: load an XLM checkpoint from disk extracting model state dict, params config, and word2id vocabulary
save_pytorch_weights: save the extracted PyTorch model state dict to a weights file in the output directory
save_xlm_config_vocab: save the XLM configuration and vocabulary as JSON files in the output directory
